question: The Reserve Bank of India launched the PRAVAAH portal with effect from _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tue Apr 01 2025 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PRAVAAH Portal:** The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** launched the **PRAVAAH portal** to streamline regulatory processes and approvals.
 
• **Launch Date:** The portal became effective on **April 1, 2025**__, marking a significant step in improving the efficiency of regulatory workflows.
 
• **Purpose:** The PRAVAAH portal is designed to enhance **transparency, accountability, and faster processing** of regulatory applications submitted by entities regulated by the RBI.
 
• **Features:** The portal integrates a centralized platform for receiving, tracking, and processing various regulatory applications, ensuring better monitoring and communication.
 
• **Stakeholders:** It primarily benefits entities like banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), and other financial institutions under the purview of the RBI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**

 
 
• The RBI is India's central banking institution, established on **April 1, 1935**, under the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934**.
 
• Its primary functions include regulating the issue of currency, controlling inflation, supervising financial institutions, and maintaining financial stability in India.
 
 
 
• **Digital Initiatives by RBI:**
 
 
• The RBI has been proactively adopting **technology-driven solutions** to improve governance and regulatory supervision.
 
• Other initiatives include the **Centralised Information Management System (CIMS)**, **Digital Payments Index (DPI)**, and the **Account Aggregator Framework**.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of PRAVAAH Portal:**
 
 
• It ensures **timely approvals** for regulated entities, reducing delays in decision-making processes.
 
• The portal enhances **compliance monitoring** and facilitates better data management for the RBI.
 
• It aligns with the government’s vision of **Digital India**, promoting the use of digital platforms for governance.
 
 
 
• **Regulated Entities under RBI:**
 
 
• The RBI regulates a wide range of financial entities, including **scheduled banks, cooperative banks, NBFCs, payment systems, and credit rating agencies**.
 
• The introduction of PRAVAAH aims to simplify compliance procedures for these entities.
